summary: You take one listed core course for at least 4 units, then move in 8 units of second-year or higher language study, 7 units of literature and 4 units of creative writing or translation courses that your faculty advisor agrees to, for at least six courses of 3 units or more and 23 units, all letter graded. The first-year language preparation and the capstone translation project are checked by hand, and AP and transfer credit do not count.

CaGRKzoX.why: "Students must complete a first-year course set or test into second year or higher in the language of interest." Any language, by course or placement, so a person checks it.

cAKH2w8z.why: "Complete at least one of the listed Core Courses for a minimum of 4 units."

AgcVjkD6.why: "At least 8 units, second year or beyond (not including conversation/oral communication). Up to three BOSP and SLE units may be considered in consultation with the faculty advisor." Any language, and the level is not in the course data, so the student moves the courses in.

EOlCmhMR.why: "At least 7 units in literature courses taught in a DLCL department, East Asian Languages and Cultures, Classics, Religious Studies, or other relevant departments determined in consultation with the faculty advisor." Which courses are literature courses, and which other departments count, is the advisor's call.

HwTdlfw5.why: "At least 4 units in a creative writing course or a course that foregrounds translation in departments, such as ... determined in consultation with the faculty advisor."

LgeDWeFV.why: "Students must complete a capstone project: a significant translation and/or translation studies project ... This work may be carried out under the supervision of an instructor in a required course." No separate course, so it is marked met by hand.

program.why: Grading: "All courses must be taken for a letter grade."

totals.label: Six courses
totals.why: Requirements Overview: "Complete at least six courses at three units or more and 23 overall units of coursework in the department." The three-unit floor on each of the six is left to the advisor, since the language, literature and elective courses are moved in by hand.
